blocks.title: Atomic orbital
blocks.text: Atomic orbital nucleus ke gird space ka woh three-dimensional hissa hai jahan electron ke milne ki probability (imkaan) sab se zyada hoti hai.
Aaiye alag orbitals ko ek ek kar ke dekhte hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Orbit (Bohr) ek pakki circle jaisi line thi jis par electron chalta tha. Orbital koi line nahi, balke ek cloud (badal) jaisa hissa hai jahan electron ke milne ka chance sab se zyada hai.

items: Orbital nucleus ke gird woh three-dimensional hissa hai jahan electron milne ki probability sab se zyada hai.
